description: Sample a video at a chosen interval and download PNG frames in a ZIP for review or reference. Up to 32 MiB input/output and ten minutes of media. FFmpeg WebAssembly runs in a worker; small settings and clips work best on mobile. Automatic mode may use native FFmpeg in Kubernetes when the browser runs out of resources. At most 100 frames. Sampling interval and maximum output dimensions keep output bounded. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: video_frames
title: Extract video frames
